{
  "test_name": "Ledger_2283_Objection3",
  "test_code": "using System;\nusing System.Collections.Immutable;\nusing System.IO;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator.Analyzers;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Diagnostics;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Emit;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\nusing Xunit;\n\npublic class Ledger_2283_Objection3\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task NestedClosedGenericValueTypes_FromReferencedAssembly_GenerateResolverWithoutCrash()\n    {\n        string libSource = \"\"\"\nusing MessagePack;\n\nnamespace Lib;\n\npublic class OuterClass<T>\n{\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public partial record struct InnerRecordStruct<U>([property: Key(0)] T First, [property: Key(1)] U Second);\n}\n\npublic struct OuterStruct<T>\n{\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public partial struct InnerStruct<U>\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public T First { get; set; }\n\n        [Key(1)]\n        public U Second { get; set; }\n    }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        string appSource = \"\"\"\nusing MessagePack;\nusing Lib;\n\nnamespace App;\n\n[MessagePackObject]\npublic sealed partial record Cmd([property: Key(0)] string Scope)\n{\n    [Key(1)]\n    public OuterClass<int>.InnerRecordStruct<string> Member1 { get; init; }\n\n    [Key(2)]\n    public OuterStruct<int>.InnerStruct<string> Member2 { get; init; }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        await VerifyAppCompilesAndAnalyzesCleanlyAsync(libSource, appSource);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task NestedClosedGenericValueType_WithUnkeyedMetadataMember_DoesNotCrashOrReportInvalidLocation()\n    {\n        string libSource = \"\"\"\nusing MessagePack;\n\nnamespace Lib;\n\npublic class Outer<T>\n{\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public partial struct InnerWithUnkeyed<U>\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public T First { get; set; }\n\n        [Key(1)]\n        public U Second { get; set; }\n\n        public int UnkeyedMetadataMember { get; set; }\n    }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        string appSource = \"\"\"\nusing MessagePack;\nusing Lib;\n\nnamespace App;\n\n[MessagePackObject]\npublic sealed partial record Cmd([property: Key(0)] string Scope)\n{\n    [Key(1)]\n    public Outer<int>.InnerWithUnkeyed<string> Member { get; init; }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        await VerifyAppCompilesAndAnalyzesCleanlyAsync(libSource, appSource);\n    }\n\n    private static async Task VerifyAppCompilesAndAnalyzesCleanlyAsync(string libSource, string appSource)\n    {\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> frameworkRefs = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> baseReferences = frameworkRefs.AddRange(ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack));\n\n        CSharpCompilation libCompilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"Lib\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(libSource, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest)) },\n            baseReferences,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        using MemoryStream libStream = new MemoryStream();\n        EmitResult libEmit = libCompilation.Emit(libStream);\n        Assert.True(libEmit.Success, string.Join(Environment.NewLine, libEmit.Diagnostics));\n        MetadataReference libReference = MetadataReference.CreateFromImage(libStream.ToArray());\n\n        CSharpCompilation appCompilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"App\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(appSource, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest)) },\n            baseReferences.Add(libReference),\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(appCompilation, out Compilation outputCompilation, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(runResult.Diagnostics, d => d.Id == \"CS8785\" || d.Severity >= DiagnosticSeverity.Warning);\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(generatorDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"CS8785\" || d.Severity >= DiagnosticSeverity.Warning);\n        Assert.Contains(\n            runResult.Results.SelectMany(r => r.GeneratedSources),\n            s => s.HintName.Contains(\"Resolver\", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)\n                 || s.SourceText.ToString().Contains(\"GeneratedMessagePackResolver\", StringComparison.Ordinal));\n\n        using MemoryStream appStream = new MemoryStream();\n        EmitResult appEmit = outputCompilation.Emit(appStream);\n        Assert.True(appEmit.Success, string.Join(Environment.NewLine, appEmit.Diagnostics));\n\n        ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> analyzerDiagnostics = await appCompilation\n            .WithAnalyzers(ImmutableArray.Create<DiagnosticAnalyzer>(new MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer()))\n            .GetAnalyzerDiagnosticsAsync();\n\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(analyzerDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"AD0001\");\n        Assert.All(analyzerDiagnostics, d =>\n        {\n            Assert.True(d.Location.IsInSource);\n            Assert.True(appCompilation.ContainsSyntaxTree(d.Location.SourceTree));\n        });\n        Assert.Empty(analyzerDiagnostics);\n    }\n}\n"
}
